name: one.asterism/asterism-mcp
description: Asterism documents, designs, PDF, Sheets, Slides, Markdown and HTML over MCP with OAuth sign-in.

tools.name: asterism_status
tools.description: Check the current Asterism MCP connection status, identity type (guest or account), and workspace storage usage.

tools.name: asterism_studios_list
tools.description: List available Asterism Studios and their enabled access modes for this connection.

tools.name: asterism_studio_describe
tools.description: Inspect a Studio's capabilities, available tools, and whether AI actions consume credits.

tools.name: asterism_load_tools
tools.description: Load detailed input schemas and annotations for selected tools in a Studio before invoking them.

tools.name: asterism_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a Studio tool (read, edit, export, or AI). Account work requires sign-in and an approved connection. Asterism AI requires sign-in, AI permission approval, and workspace credits. Follow the instructions in tool responses when access is unavailable or storage is low. If a capability is missing, an operation is blocked, or a tool repeatedly fails, explain the block clearly in the user language, ask for their explicit consent, and call asterism_submit_feedback with a concise summary (never include private document contents or raw secrets) and the requestId. Reuse the same callId when retrying an edit or AI call; omit callId to start a new operation. To run several reads and edits in one request, pass calls instead of tool and arguments: they run in the given order and stop at the first failure, and a turnId returned by edit.begin inside calls is passed to the calls after it.

tool.description: One call: the Studio tool name. Omit when calls is given.

arguments.description: One call: the tool arguments. Omit when calls is given.

calls.description: An ordered batch of read and edit calls instead of tool and arguments. Export, asset, image, request and AI tools are not accepted here; call them one at a time. The result lists one entry per call that ran, and stoppedAt is the index of the call that failed.

callId.description: Idempotency key reused when retrying an operation; omit to start a new operation.

tools.name: asterism_submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit a bug report, feature request, or support inquiry to the Asterism team when blocked or when a capability is missing. Ask for explicit user consent first and send only a concise summary without private document contents or secrets.

category.description: Type of inquiry: bug, feature_request, or support.

description.description: Concise problem or request summary (no private document contents or secrets).

locale.description: User language code such as ko, en, zh-CN.

callId.description: Optional idempotency key reused when retrying the same feedback submission.
